articles.title: Bengaluru content creator says, "I crossed Rs 10 lakh in October," revealing how 16 brand deals, Durga Puja campaigns and 30+ videos helped her earn over Rs 10 lakh in a month

articles.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope (30th November–6th December 2026): Rahu Enters Capricorn as Major Changes in Career, Relationships and Personal Goals Begin
articles.description: The Capricorn Weekly Horoscope points to an important week of personal development, professional responsibilities, and financial adjustments. Rahu and Ketu will transit on 5th December. This will be particularly significant as Rahu enters your sign and Ketu moves into Cancer. This may bring changes in your personality, relationships and approach towards life. You may become more ambitious and eager to achieve your goals. Avoid taking decisions under pressure. Maintaining emotional balance and clear priorities will help you make better progress.

articles.title: Norway welcomes US tariff move, says talks will continue
articles.description: Norway has expressed satisfaction with the US decision to refrain from imposing new tariffs on its goods. Foreign Minister Espen Barth Eide emphasized that Norwegian policies do not contribute to industrial overcapacity issues. Constructive discussions have taken place with the US Trade Representative regarding this matter. Norway aims to maintain a predictable business environment for its companies as these discussions continue.
